hook.text: In Mohawk one word can express what takes an entire English sentence to say.

buildup.text: Polysynthetic languages incorporate nouns, verbs, and modifiers into single colossal words.

discovery.text: Inuktitut's 'tusaatsiarunnanngittualuujunga' means 'I can't hear very well.'

twist.text: These languages blur the line between word and sentence—a single word is a full proposition.

climax.text: Polysynthesis is most common among indigenous languages of North America and Siberia.

quiz.question: What do polysynthetic languages do?
options: Pack sentence-level meaning into single words
